name: CMIP6 ESM air-sea CO2 flux simulations (fgco2)
model_or_instrument: ACCESS-ESM1-5, CanESM5, CNRM-ESM2-1, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MIROC-ES2L, MPI-ESM1-2-LR, UKESM1-0-LL
resolution: regridded to 1 deg latitude by 1 deg longitude grid

scales.note: CMIP6 fgco2 monthly output regridded to 1x1 degree for 2015-2100 SSP scenario projections across 7 ESMs.
